name: blackswan-xsmom
description: The PAPER-GRADE cross-sectional momentum / reversal probe (Jegadeesh-Titman 1993) — the founding cross-sectional anomaly, re-tested to supersede the B1-era xsection nulls which ranked SURVIVORSHIP-BIASED megacaps (today's winners, chosen after the fact) over two windows. This runs the identical deterministic ranking rule (trainer.xsection) on the SURVIVORSHIP-FREE diversified panel (7 commodities + SPY/TLT/IEF/UUP, daily from 2006), dollar-neutral LONG-top-k / SHORT-bottom-k (momentum) or the exact rank inversion (reversal), monthly-rebalanced, turnover-costed at a realistic per-side fee, across the full 17-window deep-history DSR gate. Market-neutral, so there is no single-asset beta and the decider is the DSR-deflated oos_sharpe. Rank from past-only trailing return, book applied next bar, holes never forward-filled. Deterministic and model-free. DATA: commodities/<SYM>-1d-*.json + etfs/<SYM>-1d-*.json.

universe.description: The PRE-REGISTERED symbol universe ranked against itself. diversified is the SURVIVORSHIP-FREE panel (7 commodities + SPY/TLT/IEF/UUP, daily from 2006), matching tsmom so the time-series and cross-sectional refutations run on the same data. Choosing symbols after seeing results is selection-on-test, so the list is fixed and never tuned.

lookback.description: Trailing bars used to rank the universe (the formation window). 126 ~ 6m, 252 ~ 12m (canonical cross-sectional momentum), 63 ~ 3m. Must be >= 1: a non-positive window inverts the ranking into a forward ratio and reads the future, so it is refused.

signal.description: momentum longs the top-k / shorts the bottom-k trailing-return names (the published rule); reversal is the exact rank inversion (mirror control). Dollar-neutral either way. An unknown value is refused.

k.description: How many symbols on each side (long k / short k). With an 11-asset basket k=3 leaves 5 flat; a universe with fewer than 2k rankable names declines to trade rather than double-book the middle.

rebalance_days.description: Bars between re-rankings (21 ~ monthly). Turnover — and therefore cost — scales with this.

long_only.description: Drop the short leg (hold only the top k). The long/short book is NET FLAT by construction; long-only reintroduces market beta, so it is the reference arm, not the thesis.

transaction_fee.description: Per-unit-of-turnover cost charged both ways (~0.1% round trip) — realistic for liquid futures/ETFs.

walk_forward_window.description: Which out-of-sample year is ACCOUNTED. The ranking may look back into the train span for its formation window, but only the test year's P&L is reported. A real cross-sectional edge must clear DSR-Sharpe in a MAJORITY of these 17 years.

seed.description: Present for contract conformance only — the screen is fully deterministic, so seeds are not swept.
